name: AFFIN
recent: AFFIN Bank 于2026年11月16日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，净利同比下滑。董事会及多个委员会在10月出现人事变动。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日季度的业绩。
Dato' Abdul Aziz Bin Abu Bakar 出现董事会及审计委员会、提名与薪酬委员会成员变动。
risks: 季度净利同比下降，主要受较高减值拨备和营运开支影响。
分析员指出赚幅承压及存款竞争可能影响FY2026目标达成。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为 MYR 647.393 million，环比下降0.9%，同比上升3.1%；净利为 MYR 127.522 million，环比下降5.9%，同比下降11.1%；净利率为19.7%，低于上一季度的20.7%。

recent_en: AFFIN Bank released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 16 November 2026, with net profit declining year-on-year. Several senior management personnel reported disposals of ordinary shares in the open market during the same period. There were board and committee changes in October.
notable_en: Announced results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Dato' Abdul Aziz Bin Abu Bakar had changes in boardroom and memberships of the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee.

Several senior management personnel (including Group Chief Community Banking Officer, Group Chief Compliance Officer, Group Chief Internal Auditor and Group Chief People Officer) reported disposals of ordinary shares.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit declined year-on-year, mainly due to higher impairment provisions and operating expenses.
Analysts noted margin pressure and deposit competition may affect the achievement of FY2026 targets.
Several senior management personnel disposed of company shares recently.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 647.393 million, down 0.9% QoQ and up 3.1% YoY; net income was MYR 127.522 million, down 5.9% QoQ and down 11.1% YoY; net margin was 19.7%, lower than 20.7% in the previous quarter.
